purpose: Hold grief terms as navigational language without letting them become therapy, diagnosis, stage models, or moral commands.

boundaries.supported_use: describe nonlinear return of grief and ordinary sensory/social triggers
boundaries.prohibited_use: claim that grief follows a predictable schedule or that a wave is failure

boundaries.supported_use: document when people use stage language
boundaries.prohibited_use: present stages as required sequence or measure of progress

boundaries.supported_use: define as reviewed diagnostic vocabulary and route to qualified help when impairment or danger appears
boundaries.prohibited_use: label ordinary intense grief from archive data

boundaries.supported_use: document ongoing relationship practices and models
name grief without public social role or permission
boundaries.prohibited_use: expose hidden relationships or rank grief legitimacy

boundaries.supported_use: record what social phrases do in context
boundaries.prohibited_use: offer universal scripts or correct all mourners

default_public_rule: Any public surface must pair grief vocabulary with nonpathology language and clear crisis/support routing where safety is a concern.
